2493-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2493-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

401-3944-7192-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-7192-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

3188-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

950-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Fatestitcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
950-5107-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

3099-3755-3812.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
3099-3755-3812.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-3755-3812.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

277-5531-5694-6927-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-5531-5694-6927-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-5531-5694-6927-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Damage Control Crew and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

2866-4211-4986-6495.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2866-4211-4986-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4067-4316-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2173-2448-5220-7492.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-7492.description:
Cast Goblin Firestarter by paying its mana cost.
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1895-4399-4770-5468.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4770-5468.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

413-1580-4556-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Blight Mound and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
647-3259-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-3301-7434--148.notablePrerequisites:
There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
1978-3301-7434--148.description:
Animate Brass Infiniscope.
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
1978-3301-7434--148.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

339-677-2438-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

553-7164.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Solve the Equation by paying {U}, searching your library for Approach of the Second Sun and putting it into your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2068-2762-5231-5346.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability twice by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {R},
Crime Novelist triggers, causing you to add {R} and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the other Thopter token.
Ashnod and Crime Novelist trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ashnod trigger, copying Thopter Squadron's ability.
Resolve both Thopter Squadron abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it,.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5686-6273.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1879-2872-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2097-3129-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2097-3129-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor and Jolene.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
2097-3129-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

1636-2511-4023-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-2511-4023-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

4613-4968-6825.description:
Activate MJ by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
MJ triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2457-4365-5794-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Frog and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3562-3817-5686-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

428-804-1694-3090.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
428-804-1694-3090.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima the Impostor.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

586-5258-5618-5686-5687.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1393-2364-4050-4986.manaNeeded: {1} if the permanent requires four or more mana to cast
1393-2364-4050-4986.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent card in hand that can be cast using {C}{C} and two colored mana.
1393-2364-4050-4986.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the historic permanent from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 3.
1393-2364-4050-4986.notes: If the historic permanent can be cast for less than {C}{C} and two colored mana, this combo nets infinite mana.

1049-2440-4871-5147.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{W}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable, or an additional {R}, {W} or {B} if you haven't cast Jirina from the command zone this game
1049-2440-4871-5147.description:
Cast Jirina from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Jirina trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token for each time you've cast Jirina from the command zone this game.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Human and Soldier you control.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining Mana Echoes trigger created in steps 2 and 4.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Jirina and a Human Soldier.
Choose to return Jirina to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Jirina and the Human Soldier die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, if you control a Human Soldier, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a Human Soldier.
If you sacrificed a Human Soldier this way, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 7 and 10, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate up to three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding any combination of {R}, {W} and {B}.
Repeat.

3617-3662-3942.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {3}{R}{R}{R} each extra turn
3617-3662-3942.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Time Walk from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chemister from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-5663--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2292-5663--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

413-5191.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You have a way to give Raptor Hatchling indestructible.
413-5191.description:
Give Raptor Hatchling indestructible, if needed.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control, dealing 1 damage to Raptor Hatchling.
Raptor Hatchling triggers, creating a 3/3 Dinosaur creature token.
When the Dinosaur enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat from step 2.

1082-1636-2034-3652-4782.notablePrerequisites:
Heidar does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
1082-1636-2034-3652-4782.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Dual Nature's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Ornithopter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ornithopter token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Heidar by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling nothing.
Repeat.

729-1952-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Livio does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
729-1952-3542.description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Livio's first ability twice by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Palinchron and Great Oak Guardian with aegis counters on them.
Activate Livio's second ability by paying {2}{W} and tapping it, returning Palinchron and Great Oak Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
Great Oak Guardian and Palinchron enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping each creature you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

341-1824-2661.notablePrerequisites:
You have not completed nor are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
"Creature" chosen with Umori.
341-1824-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Acererak by paying {1}{B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Acererak enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to venture into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

3490-3597-4659.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
3490-3597-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Juri triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
3490-3597-4659.notes: You can sacrifice Juri to deal infinite damage to any target once you stop the loop.

4191-4415.description:
Cast Stonecloaker without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers both of its enter abilities.
Resolve one Stonecloaker ability, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the other Stonecloaker ability, exiling a card from a graveyard if applicable.
Repeat.

3492-3609-5217.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper and Order of Whiteclay do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block and kill Order of Whiteclay.
3492-3609-5217.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Declare Order of Whiteclay as an attacker.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {1}{W}{W} and untapping it, return Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
